language_id_caveat: langdetect has no 'bho' label; Devanagari-script-ratio was used as a practical proxy and cannot distinguish Bhojpuri from closely-related Hindi/Nepali text mislabeled at the source. likely_hindi_contamination is a coarse lexical-marker count (see clean_lib.marker_counts) among docs that otherwise passed cleaning - it is NOT a filter, documents counted here are still included in data/cleaned/. Flags docs where Hindi markers (है/हैं/एक/गया/हुआ/किया/आप/तुम्हारा) outnumber Bhojpuri markers (बा/बाटे/बाड़ें/एगो/गइल/भइल/कइल/etc.) by a clear margin.
